summary: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, and Odesa, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Ukraine intercepted multiple drones and missiles, with reports of casualties and damage in Zaporizhzhia and Zhytomyr. NATO exercises demonstrated Ukrainian naval capabilities, while EU sanctions against Russia expanded to 218 measures.
key_points: Multiple drone attacks reported across northern and eastern Ukraine including Sumy, Chernihiv, and Kharkiv regions. (Source: @kpszsu/69916)
SeaBnigs drone reportedly downed a $50 million Buk-M3 missile system in Donetsk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)
Russian forces struck Zaporizhzhia with KAB bombs causing 16 casualties and damaging residential buildings. (Source: @UkraineNow/82858)
Drone attacks on Odesa region from Black Sea targeting Tuzli and Vilke areas. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69332)
Rocket attack on Obukhiv near Kyiv reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69357)
EU approved 218th package of sanctions against Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/82854)
Ukrainian naval forces received NATO command certification during Sea Breeze 2026 exercises. (Source: @UkraineNow/82881)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted extensive drone and missile strikes across Ukraine targeting infrastructure, civilian areas, and military positions. Ukrainian air defenses successfully intercepted multiple threats while reporting casualties from attacks in Zaporizhzhia and Zhytomyr regions. NATO exercises demonstrated Ukrainian naval interoperability capabilities while EU sanctions expanded significantly against Russia.

points: Drone expert Sergei Beskrestnov published map showing potential attack zones for Russian Geranium drones covering Kiev, Poltava, Dnepr, and other major cities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31871)
Ukrainian drone downed Russian Buk-M3 missile system worth $50 million in Donetsk region during night operations on July 23. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)
President Zelensky scheduled to meet with Raytheon company executives to discuss joint production of Patriot missile system components in Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/82863)
Polish government proposed joint US-Ukrainian production of Patriot missiles with manufacturing facilities in Ukraine for security reasons. (Source: @UkraineNow/82875)
Ukrainian naval forces achieved NATO Evaluation Level 2 certification during Sea Breeze 2026 exercises, enabling command of multinational mine countermeasures operations. (Source: @UkraineNow/82881)
President Zelensky to visit US for official meetings including with President Trump and funeral of Senator Lindsey Graham. (Source: @UkraineNow/82872)
Military state of emergency and general mobilization extended through October 31, 2026 by presidential decree. (Source: @UkraineNow/82880)
Russian Defense Ministry reported liberation of 8 settlements in DPR, Zaporizhzhia, Dnepropetrovsk, and Kharkiv regions over past week. (Source: @tass_agency/386854)
Russian forces struck port infrastructure in Odesa, Chernomorsk, Yuzhny, Izmail, and Nikolaev with 18 group and massed strikes between July 18-24. (Source: @tass_agency/386854)
Russian Aerospace Forces claimed to have shot down 5,249 Ukrainian drones of aircraft type over past week. (Source: @tass_agency/386854)
Russian Navy destroyed seven unmanned surface vessels used by Ukrainian forces over past week. (Source: @tass_agency/386854)

key_developments: Russian forces conducted extensive drone and missile strikes across Ukraine targeting infrastructure, civilian areas, and military positions with multiple attacks detected in Kyiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, and Odesa regions. (Source: @kpszsu/69916)

Ukrainian drone downed Russian Buk-M3 missile system worth $50 million in Donetsk region during night operations on July 23, demonstrating successful counter-drone capabilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/82856)

Russian forces struck Zaporizhzhia with KAB bombs causing 16 casualties and damaging residential buildings, while attacks in Zhytomyr hit fuel facilities and Slavyansk residential construction caused 14 casualties. (Source: @UkraineNow/82858)
Drone attacks on Odesa region from Black Sea targeted Tuzli and Vilke areas, while similar attacks detected on Mykolaiv and Kherson regions from southern directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69332)

EU approved 218th package of sanctions against Russia expanding economic pressure while NATO exercises demonstrated Ukrainian naval interoperability capabilities through Sea Breeze 2026 certification. (Source: @UkraineNow/82854)

Russian Defense Ministry reported liberation of 8 settlements and destruction of port infrastructure in Odesa, Chernomorsk, Yuzhny, Izmail, and Nikolaev with 18 group and massed strikes between July 18-24. (Source: @tass_agency/386854)

President Zelensky scheduled to visit US for official meetings including with President Trump and funeral of Senator Lindsey Graham while military state of emergency extended through October 31, 2026. (Source: @UkraineNow/82872)
